content.text:
LaV2BiO8 (mp-1222712) is the phase present, and probably the only one, though the fit is imperfect.

- **Single-phase fits:** LaV2BiO8 fits best on its own, with an R-factor of 0.736 at −1.5 % strain. The next two candidates I fitted alone, SrSc2O4 and Mn2V3NiO8, fit almost nothing (R about 0.98). I did not fit the other six alone; I only tested them as second phases.
- **What it accounts for:** it covers all the major observed peaks, at about 18.3°, 24.4°, 30.1°, 31.55°, 32.75° and 37°.
- **What is left over:** the residual mostly has a plus-then-minus shape at those same peak positions. That shape means the fitted peaks sit slightly off the observed ones, so it looks like a lattice mismatch rather than a second phase. A few positive bumps also remain near 32.3° and 56.6°, and none of the other candidates explains them.
- **Second-phase tests:** adding any of the other six candidates to LaV2BiO8 only lowers R from 0.736 to between 0.719 and 0.732. None of them removes the structured residual.

Confidence is 0.7 rather than higher because R stays high even for the best fit and a few small residual bumps are unexplained.

{"present": ["mp-1222712"], "confidence": 0.7, "note": "LaV2BiO8 accounts for all major peaks and no other candidate meaningfully improves the fit; the remaining residual mostly looks like slightly misplaced peaks rather than a second phase."}
